question: Can one stock Core2 guest complete a second external NUS GATT transaction after the peer disconnects?

baseline.interpretation: The first BLE transaction and a two-minute active-link hold pass. They do not prove a second connection in the same guest.

variants.name: stock-advertising-lifecycle
variants.guest_changes: none; stock BLEUARTServer does not schedule a second advertisement after disconnect

variants.name: guest-scheduled-readvertise
variants.guest_changes: test-only ReconnectableBLEUARTServer schedules gap_advertise 500 ms after disconnect

classification.result: same-guest disconnect lifecycle fails before re-advertising
confirmed: Both stock and test-only readvertising variants complete cycle 1 and disconnect cycle 1.
Both variants then emit repeated NimBLE 'HCI process ack returned 12' log messages and never expose a second advertisement.
The stock-advertising variant does not execute the test-only gap_advertise path, so guest readvertising is not the sole trigger.
No guest panic was observed; the reproduction is a controller/HCI command lifecycle failure, not the earlier cache panic.
not_claimed: a root cause in QEMU HLI delivery, firmware NimBLE, or Bumble without further HCI transaction tracing
physical RF, bit-exact ESP32 BT controller/baseband or controller firmware equivalence
next_checks: Capture H2C/C2H command and event pairs around the disconnect event and the first failing host command.
Repeat disconnect without any guest re-advertise or reconnect attempt and classify whether NimBLE resets by itself.
Separate controller event ordering from Bumble Command Disallowed replies before changing guest or controller-hook code.
